Factory CODE unchanged → canonical factory STAYS v4 (0xa1A8…); it was merely repointed via setImplementation(implV5) + setBondManager(bondV2). Deployed + ONCHAIN VERIFIED on Sepolia 2026-07-19 (5 deploy txs status 0x1 + 1 createMarket proof tx). All fixes fork-proven 4/4 (contracts/perps/test/SecurityFixesV5.t.sol) against live Sepolia Chainlink. Existing v4-created markets keep impl v4; NEW markets minted by the factory clone impl v5 (proven: clone 0xeccc9ec8… runtime bytecode → impl v5).
